desc:
🥚 Rope an Egg! 🐎
Saddle up, grab your lasso, and hunt rare eggs while escaping dangerous monsters!

🎮 Gameplay Features
• Hunt & Lasso: Ride your horse, lasso unique eggs, and drag them safely back to your base.
• Survive Monsters: Outrun dangerous monsters hunting you as you explore new lands.
• Upgrade & Progress: Earn cash to unlock faster horses, stronger lassos, and better gear.
• Secret Discoveries: Explore new areas to find rare, legendary, and secret eggs.

👍 Like the game & Join the Group for rewards!
Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.
